editorial:
Imagine a getaway driver who never takes off his earbuds. Baby is a young guy with a ringing in his ears, so he plays music to drown it out while pulling off wild heists. He works for a crime boss named Doc, who keeps pulling him back in. When Baby meets a sweet waitress named Debora, he finally wants a normal life. The whole movie feels like a music video mixed with a crime story, full of energy and style.

The car chases are some of the best you will ever see, with every move synced to the beat of the soundtrack. The cast is stacked, including Kevin Spacey, Jamie Foxx, and Jon Hamm. Pros: amazing music, thrilling action, and a fresh style. Cons: some side characters feel flat, and the romance moves fast. Watch this if you want a fun, stylish ride. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Baby tries to escape with Debora, but the heist goes wrong and his partners turn on each other. Buddy chases Baby and Debora, leading to a crash. Baby is caught and sent to prison. Years later, he is released on parole, and Debora is waiting for him outside. They drive off together, finally free to start a new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish action movies with great music.
